name: phonetic
description:
Each word read as English and written in Russian.

«Dreamline» → «Дримлайн», «iphone» → «айфон», «google» → «гугл». A word keeps its case: lower, capitalised or upper («XIAOMI» → «СЯОМИ»); a word of mixed case comes out lower. The words are joined by one space.

Example: semkit read --text "Dreamline" --text "iphone" phonetic write -
-> Дримлайн; айфон

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
